content: I've tried rerunning the CI for cslib#628 twice. Each time it exits with Error: The operation was canceled. during lake lint. Any ideas what's happening?
Okay, running locally seems to cause my terminal and/or computer to crash! Not sure how to debug what's happening here.

I downloaded the branch and ran lake build successfully. I'm running lake lint now. Something has changed: lake lint used to be pretty fast to finish, but now it first print a very long list of files:

Default modules: #[Cslib, Cslib.Crypto.Protocols.PerfectSecrecy.Encryption, Cslib.Crypto.Protocols.PerfectSecrecy.Internal.OneTimePad, [...]

and then linting each file very slowly:

-- Linting passed for Cslib.
-- Linting passed for Cslib.Crypto.Protocols.PerfectSecrecy.Encryption.
-- Linting passed for Cslib.Crypto.Protocols.PerfectSecrecy.Internal.OneTimePad.
-- Linting passed for Cslib.Crypto.Protocols.PerfectSecrecy.Internal.PerfectSecrecy.
[...]

I'ver never seen this behavior before.
OK, lake lint completed after (perhaps) 5 min. Running lake test now...
lake test completed.
Anything else I can try?
What OS are you on?
MacOS running on M1 MacBook Pro.
I ran the lake commands in a shell running in Emacs.
Okay, thanks. Re the listing of modules, this is expected to be different given some recent changes to linting.
MacOS Tahoe 26.3.1, to be precise.
lake lint now takes a lot longer than before.
What OS are you on?
Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS, the same as CI, so something OS specific maybe.
Perhaps after all softwares are verified in Lean, such things won't happen again. :wink:

Ching-Tsun Chou said:

I'ver never seen this behavior before.

This is new behavior as of https://github.com/leanprover-community/batteries/pull/1847

The cause is currently https://github.com/leanprover/cslib/blob/main/lakefile.toml#L25, which says "cslib is a collection of possibly-unrelated modules". This line can be removed if mk_all is added as CI step
Otherwise, https://github.com/leanprover-community/batteries/pull/1850 will also fix it
We already have mk_all running in CI, so this glob can just be removed, right?

Chris Henson said:

Okay, thanks. Re the listing of modules, this is expected to be different given some recent changes to linting.

Just for posterity: I was getting this confused with lean4#13917, which is about module syntax linters, the environment linters should just list Cslib as before. The (unused) globs are now removed and this works as expected. Thanks for the help Eric!

Chris Henson said:

this is expected to be different given some recent changes to linting.

Chris Henson said:

the environment linters should just list Cslib as before.

Just to be clear, the listing of modules changed because of batteries#1847.
Yes, I understand. This was what I meant in my last message above.
